person: Marcus Lindqvist, a retired machinist in Duluth whose 2019 Kestrel pickup is in the fuel pump recall. He keeps every receipt in a folder and answers in a few words.

stated_up_front.text: The pump was replaced on 3 March this year, 2026.

sheet.truth: Ask me first: show me the claim before it goes in.

sheet.about: when the fuel pump was replaced
sheet.truth: The fuel pump was replaced on 3 March 2026 at Garrowby Service.

sheet.about: whether a warranty or roadside cover paid any part of the fuel pump repair
sheet.truth: No. Nothing on the fuel pump went through a warranty or roadside cover; I paid it all myself.

sheet.about: whether any other vehicle in the household is in the recall
sheet.truth: Only my 2019 Kestrel pickup. My wife's car is a different make and is not in the recall.
